title: 腾讯Dawson Tong：被指追赶字节阿里，船到底漏在哪？
speaker: Dawson Tong

segments.en: Do you feel though that Tencent is sort of playing catch-up to some of the other larger players, whether it's bite dance or Ali Baba?
segments.zh: 你是否觉得腾讯在追赶其他大型玩家，比如字节跳动或阿里巴巴？

segments.en: I mean, Ponemah has talked about it as well, as we're onboard the ship right now.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，Ponemah也谈到了这一点，就像我们现在在船上一样。

segments.en: But maybe the ship has been a bit leaky. Where do you think you've been leaky in the development?
segments.zh: 但也许这艘船有点漏水。你认为在发展中哪里出现了漏洞？

segments.en: Because you've also talked about you, maybe in the early days, did not prioritize the hiring of top level engineers
segments.zh: 因为你也谈到过，也许在早期，没有优先招聘顶级工程师

segments.en: and like, where are you right now? How would you assess how you're trying to capitalize on the AI buildout?
segments.zh: 那么你现在处于什么位置？你如何评估你试图利用AI建设的方式？

segments.en: Well, as I mentioned, there are multiple layers that we play in the stack.
segments.zh: 嗯，正如我提到的，我们在技术栈的多个层面都有参与。

segments.en: So I think we were pretty strong at the info level.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们在信息层面相当强。

segments.en: That was a time, I think, because of the lack of compute, we didn't allocate enough for model training of high.
segments.zh: 那是一个时期，我认为由于计算资源缺乏，我们没有为高级模型训练分配足够资源。

segments.en: And also, there were some team dynamics that we were trying to sort out, I would say, two years,
segments.zh: 此外，还有一些团队动态我们试图解决，我想说，两三年前。

segments.en: three years ago. But this year, in fact, we're seeing a lot of improvement with the high model, as you might see
segments.zh: 但今年，事实上，我们看到高级模型有很多改进，正如你可能看到的

segments.en: in some of the benchmarks out there.
High four preview has captured a lot of interest and also being used quite extensively.
segments.zh: High four预览版引发了大量关注，也得到了相当广泛的使用。

segments.en: Compared to roughly half a year ago when Ponemah made the statement of a leaky ship, I think we've come a long way.
segments.zh: 相比大约半年前Ponemah所说的“漏水的船”，我认为我们已经取得了长足进步。
